rule_content: Date values must use YYYY-MM-DD format
The start date must be before or equal to the end date on the same business object
scope: Start and end date field pair

rule_content: A primary-key field must be non-null and unique within its table
A code field value must belong to a confirmed code set
A field declared as non-null must always contain a valid business value
A text value must not exceed the field length declared by the schema
scope: Text fields with a declared length

rule_content: A text value must not contain unintended leading or trailing whitespace
A text value must not contain unapproved control characters
A numeric value must fit the precision and scale declared by the schema
A measure that is semantically nonnegative must be greater than or equal to zero
scope: Counts quantities durations balances and sizes

rule_content: A rate or percentage must stay within the business-confirmed range and representation
A monetary value must use the business-confirmed currency scale and rounding rule
scope: Amounts prices fees costs and balances

rule_content: A Boolean field must use only the approved true and false representations
A confirmed business key must be unique within its defined business scope
A foreign-key value must reference an existing active parent record unless explicitly optional
When present an email value must conform to the business-approved email syntax
When present a phone value must conform to the jurisdiction and business-approved phone format
When present a URL or URI must be syntactically valid and use an approved scheme
When present an IP address must be a valid approved IPv4 or IPv6 representation
A JSON value must parse successfully and conform to the approved object shape when a schema exists
A cross-system timestamp must use an unambiguous format with the approved timezone convention
The update timestamp must be greater than or equal to the creation timestamp on the same record
An observed event timestamp must not be later than the permitted ingestion-time tolerance
The effective start must be earlier than or equal to the effective end
A soft-delete flag and deletion timestamp must agree according to the approved deletion convention
Latitude must be between -90 and 90 and longitude must be between -180 and 180
Country region city and district values must form a valid hierarchy when jointly present
A code and its descriptive name must resolve to the same reference-data entry
Identifiers and codes with meaningful leading zeros must be stored and exported as text
Missing values must use the approved null representation rather than placeholder text or magic values
scope: Structured fields that permit missing values

rule_content: Sensitive values must be masked encrypted tokenized or access-controlled according to the approved security classification
scope: Personal confidential credential and financial fields

rule_content: Sensitive data must be collected and retained only when justified by an approved business purpose
